summary: At the first nearly-full bite of Tourist rations, eat.c:lesshungry asks whether to continue when victual.canchoke is true and more than one bite remains. js/eat.js refuses this prompt branch before reading the answer or updating meal state. Port the whole lesshungry function, preserving its hunger, warning, reset, prompt, and newuhs order; keep any unported choke callee explicit.

source.branch: lesshungry: u.uhunger reaches 1500 but remains below 2000, Hunger is off, victual.eating is true, fullwarn is false, canchoke is true, and reqtime-usedtime exceeds one; ask ParanoidEating before newuhs.
callers: eat.c:opentin and other nutrition paths -> eat.c:lesshungry
dependencies: cmd.c:paranoid_query is already ported in js/cmd.js and returns the yes/no result
eat.c:reset_eat and newuhs are already ported in js/eat.js
eat.c:choke remains a separate source callee for the >=2000 arm; its return is discarded

evidence: C eat.c:3289-3334 increments hunger, checks >=2000 choking first, then emits the >=1500 warning and calls paranoid_query(ParanoidEating, "Continue eating?") when a chokable meal has more than one bite left. A negative answer resets eating and clears nomovemsg; newuhs(FALSE) runs afterward.

JS js/eat.js:1912-1960 increments hunger and reaches an UnsupportedEatError at lines 1945-1953 before invoking the already ported cmd.c:paranoid_query, reset_eat, or newuhs. Other refusal arms in the same function require whole-function source review.

The independently recorded v12 Tourist recipe has 19 steps; the saved C44 evaluation stops at zero-based step 5 after five matched screens, with 14 remaining screens and the unsupported continued-eating prompt. C provenance is challenges/cases/v12/tourist-rations-reach-satiated-choke.session.json and challenges/evaluations/20260929033350-v12.json.

C cmd.c:5655-5658 defines paranoid_query as a boolean wrapper over paranoid_ynq; js/cmd.js:955 already implements it. C eat.c:245-287 choke is a separate void callee when hunger reaches 2000; it must be source-ported in a later task or marked as an explicit unported call without inventing its result.
